title: What happened to Terry McLaurin?
text:
Terry McLaurin injury: What happened to Commanders star? NFL NBA NHL MLB WNBA Outdoors Casinos Newsletter NFL What happened to Terry McLaurin?
 Robert Zeglinski For The Win Nov. 12, 2026, 7:20 p.m. ET There will be a familiar face on the Washington Commanders ' roster not suited up for Thursday night's important NFC East divisional game with the New York Giants .
 Long-time franchise cornerstone Terry McLaurin, a two-time Pro Bowler and former All-Pro, isn't playing in one of the Commanders' biggest games. Why? Because the veteran playmaker tore a patellar tendon in his knee earlier this year during a Monday night road game against the San Francisco 49ers. Not only is McLaurin not playing on Thursday night, but he is also out for the rest of the season .
 It's a brutal blow to the Commanders' offense and the organization as a whole, to be sure.

His best individual season came in 2024, when he also finished second in the NFL in touchdown catches with 13. Those Commanders, perhaps not by coincidence, made it all the way to the NFC title game.
 The modern Commanders as we know them aren't the same without McLaurin. Here's hoping for a swift recovery for the veteran receiver.
